title: Victor Amadeus I of Savoy and Canisy to Henri de Rohan, 27 May 1636 (BnF Français 5190 nos. 214-215)

steps.what: Checked Français 5190; view requests past 90 returned the same final image, manuscript p. 80.
Read the printed Savoy and Canisy plaintext in the 1758 Mémoires et lettres (III, pp. 76-79), printed under headings that call the letters "en chiffres".

Split from the former rohan1636 group under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): this entry keeps the Savoy and Canisy letters to Rohan (fr. 5190 nos. 214-215). Français 3758 nos. 100 and 104 are George Lasry's louis1635 and chatillon1635; d'Émery's letter and Rohan's reply (nos. 171-172) are emery1636, since no shared key is shown. The earlier steps on fr. 3758 (clear-prose transcription, Saint-Chamond comparison) stay in the NOTES as history.

outcome.method_basis: The manuscript ciphertext of the two letters is beyond the Gallica reproduction of Français 5190, so the printed 1758 plaintext could not be paired with it; no sign has a value.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No ciphertext in hand; no sign has a value.

gaps.detail: the Gallica reproduction stops at manuscript p. 80; new images or the volume itself are needed

outcome.notes: The content of both letters is known from the 1758 print; the cipher and its key are not. Split on 14 Oct 2026.

prior.where: Mémoires et lettres de Henri duc de Rohan (1758), III, pp. 76-79 (plaintext)
